caseStudies.title: Industrial visual inspection
caseStudies.problem: detect surface scratches amid texture, lighting, and camera variability
caseStudies.pipeline: camera -> normalization -> fixed edge/texture features or CNN -> threshold/review queue -> retained evidence
caseStudies.data: labeled nominal/defect frames across lighting, materials, camera states
caseStudies.tradeoffs: resolution improves small-defect evidence but increases latency; false negatives carry production risk
caseStudies.deployment: edge inference; retain frame, crop, model/filter version and illumination metadata
caseStudies.monitoring: frame drops, brightness/blur drift, anomaly rate, reviewer disagreement
caseStudies.improvements: reference targets, stratified sampling, uncertainty review

caseStudies.title: Medical imaging
caseStudies.problem: extract local structure for controlled clinician-reviewed workflows
caseStudies.pipeline: de-identified study -> modality normalization -> model response -> review workspace -> controlled record
caseStudies.data: governed, protocol-stratified data and reader-reviewed annotations
caseStudies.tradeoffs: multi-scale context versus validation and interpretability limits
caseStudies.deployment: controlled network, audit logs, human review before downstream use
caseStudies.monitoring: protocol shifts, failed processing, review overrides
caseStudies.limitations: domain shift, annotation ambiguity; no diagnostic-performance claim is made
caseStudies.improvements: reader-agreement sets and explicit abstention routing

caseStudies.title: Autonomous perception
caseStudies.problem: extract lane, boundary, and object context under real-time lighting variation
caseStudies.pipeline: synchronized cameras -> multi-channel feature extractor -> detector/segmenter -> temporal tracker -> planning interface
caseStudies.data: scenario-balanced camera streams with weather and illumination metadata
caseStudies.tradeoffs: compute budget and response latency versus feature resolution
caseStudies.deployment: vehicle edge compute with bounded queues and replay logs
caseStudies.monitoring: sensor synchronization, dropped frames, lighting cohorts, track continuity
caseStudies.limitations: occlusion, reflective surfaces, unusual layouts, sensor misalignment
caseStudies.improvements: scenario capture and temporal consistency checks
